artifacts.hook: I trained an AI to spot missing helmets. The hardest part wasn't the model - it was the data.
artifacts.caption:
I trained an AI to spot missing helmets. The hardest part wasn't the model - it was the data. 🤯

This project utilizes the YOLOv8 model to focus on helmet detection, operating in real-time. The core technology is based on deep learning, demonstrating the application of AI in safety applications. 

Seriously, collecting sufficient, diverse data for helmet detection was a surprising challenge. We spent [significant time] meticulously labeling images – variations in lighting, angles, and helmet styles threw us for a loop. It really highlighted the importance of data quality for any AI system.

We’re seeing promising results – achieving [a strong mAP score] on our test set. But building a robust, reliable system requires more than just a good model.

What are the biggest data challenges you’ve encountered in your computer vision projects? Share your experiences below! 👇
